brief:
The bombing campaign in Gaza has left a record number of children orphaned and women widowed, Middle East Eye reported. Bereaved families face compounded hardship as they navigate displacement and poverty in the aftermath.

Survivors among the displaced population struggle to secure basic necessities while grieving the loss of family members. The scale of family separation has strained already limited resources for aid organizations operating in the territory.

title: Gaza conflict creates record numbers of orphans and widows
